content:
arjun: quick RFC follow-up — proposing a "warmup + smoothing" rollout policy for fp8/int8. idea is to avoid short-lived SLO blips when the quant path first sees production traffic. comments?

maya: makes sense. what's the warmup duration and how conservative are we starting?

sasha: overall 👍 but we need to anchor this to degscore not just latency. some prompt families will surface quality cliffs during warmup.

taylor: implementation tradeoff: do we throttle at routing (route small pct to quant replicas) or enable per-worker gradual activation? routing-level is simpler but doesn't prime KV caches.
arjun: initial config sketch: {warmup_minutes: 15, initial_pct: 2, step_pct: 5, step_minutes: 5, smoothing_minutes: 10, degscore_thresh: 0.08, fallback_delay_s: 30} — start tiny, ramp up in steps, and apply a smoothing window to avoid noisy flips.

ops-bot: canary report: fp8-canary-2026-03-18 -> latency p95 +7%, degscore +0.12 on recv prompt set, partial rollback at 10% traffic.

maya: that canary matches concerns. suggestion: make smoothing window adaptive — larger during peak QPS so we don't accidentally rollback, smaller during low traffic for quicker recovery.
sasha: +1 to adaptive. also add per-customer "quality_buffer" opt that keeps enterprise customers off quant until warmup completes. default off for self-serve.
taylor: kv-cache note: quant replicas have cold caches; routing-level warmup won't prime global KV. options: pre-warm with synthetic prefixes or include a cache-penalty factor in smoothing.
arjun: agree — add a pre-warm job to prime top-N prefixes for the model during first rollout wave, and tag first-10k requests as "warmup" for observability.
maya: ops action: create metric tag for rollout_phase: warmup|ramp|steady|fallback so dashboards can filter.

sasha: edge-case: variants that change output distribution (rounding differences) might only fail on rare prefixes. backstop: if degscore > 0.15 for 3 consecutive windows, auto-roll back and open ticket.
taylor: fine with 0.15 as an initial backstop, we can tune.
arjun: action items: (1) rollout schema + server enforcement (arjun), (2) pre-warm priming job (taylor), (3) telemetry tag + warmup dashboard (maya), (4) rollback automation + playbook (sasha). i'll open RFC follow-up PR with config and canary checklist.
maya: will add dashboard template and grafana panels. :+1:
sasha: i'll draft rollback playbook and incident template.
taylor: will prototype priming job and test on next canary.
arjun: thanks all — let's sync in weekly eng-ml slot if anyone hits blockers. :)
